task.description: Queue-drain pass for ISS-0152 / GH #469: tools/lint_test_isolation.baseline.json records 128 suppressed findings but the tree produces 131; the 3 unaccounted findings are T020 MAJORs present on origin/main. Resolve each of the 3 INDIVIDUALLY -- either fix it in the test source, or add it to the baseline with a recorded reason. HARD CONSTRAINT per CLAUDE.md: do NOT blanket-regenerate the baseline, which would also silently suppress genuine violations. Identify the 3 specific findings first and report what each one is.
acceptance_criteria: The 3 unaccounted T020 findings identified individually and each fixed or deliberately baselined with a reason
Baseline suppression count matches the tree's actual suppressed findings

result.summary: ISS-0152 resolved. Root cause was NOT 3 isolation defects: the 2026-08-05 baseline was generated against a tree state 3 lines shorter than origin/main, so 94 entries carried a uniform +3 stale line offset, plus 3 entries in tests/integration/helpers.zig carried a +44 offset from ISS-0137 commit baea783 -- 97 stale entries total, of which the 3 helpers.zig ones are the T020 MAJORs reported. Each of the 3 T020 findings (cached_owner_tag:388, tag_repr_storage:393, tag_repr_lock:394) was reviewed individually and DELIBERATELY KEPT BASELINED: they are the intended per-process owner-tag cache mechanism of ISS-0602/GH #414 (commit 316d350), lock-guarded via cmpxchg with acquire/release ordering and freed by the owning TestHarness deinit; making them per-test would reintroduce the ISS-0602 cross-binary connection-kill failure. Applied a strict line-number-ONLY sync (97 entries relined, 0 added, 0 removed) that aborts rather than writing if any finding identity would change -- verified the (severity,code,file,message) identity multiset is bit-identical to the pre-change baseline, so no genuine violation could be absorbed. NOT a blanket regeneration.
